topic: Kimi K3 Now Available via Telnyx Inference API
headline: Kimi K3 Launch on Telnyx
caption: Big news from Hacker News today - Kimi K3 is now accessible through Telnyx Inference API. As a full stack engineer, I see this as a huge step toward making AI models more accessible and easier to integrate into projects. The API streamlines deployment and scaling, reducing setup time so we can focus on building smarter features. It's exciting to see cloud providers enabling seamless AI integrations, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in real-time apps. 🚀 If you're working on LLMs or AI-driven products, this update might be just what you need to accelerate your development. #AI #FullStack #TechTrends
